description: This file is the entry point for a React application, initializing the React root and rendering the main App component within StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the application, binding it to the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root DOM node, wrapping with StrictMode and rendering the App component.
